name: Dial Me Up
tagline: Daily messages for long-distance partners: photos with AR lenses, audio, drawings or letters.
problem: Long-distance relationships need small daily rituals.
solution: Partners share a passcode, send a message for each day of the week in several formats, and request messages from each other.
demo_moment: Team-described: request Thursday's message and open it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most on Theme Hack (Love)” among 212 submissions.
Fits the event's love theme directly.

lessons: Theme prizes reward heartfelt literal answers.
